name: transcript_words_window
title: Read approximate word annotations for transcript lines
description: App/internal read-only semantic locator for a small set of transcript lines on a RAW recording (the drawer, not an episode). Word annotations are approximate and never authorize a structural cut; episode editing locates candidate media with episode_read and places precise boundaries from episode_zoom or episode_sample_frames evidence.

recording_id.description: The recording public ID whose transcript lines to inspect.

line_numbers.description: Specific transcript line numbers to inspect, such as [31, 33].

start_line.description: First line in an inclusive contiguous range.

end_line.description: Last line in an inclusive contiguous range. Defaults to start_line when omitted by internal callers.

transcript_fingerprint.description: Required fingerprint for the recording's current line segmentation; prevents stale line numbers after retranscription or speaker-label changes.

segmentation_version.description: Optional segmentation version for the recording's current line segmentation.

transcript.description: Plain text timing for the requested line(s). Word-timed transcripts include word_id values for semantic anchors and local timing reference; unit fallback rows are line-selection only.
